business_summary: HPGC Renmintongtai Pharmaceutical Corporation engages in the wholesale and retail of pharmaceutical products in China and internationally. The company offers chemical drugs, traditional Chinese medicine, biological products, and medical supplies; medical instruments, traditional Chinese medicine decoction pieces, health foods, daily necessities, glassware, and chemical reagents, etc.; It serves its products through e-commerce platforms, direct sales, and a chain of direct stores and online B2C, O2O, etc. The company was founded in 1950 and is headquartered in Harbin, China. HPGC Renmintongtai Pharmaceutical Corporation is a subsidiary of Harbin Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd.
business_summary_ko: HPGC Renmintongtai Pharmaceutical Corporation은 중국 및 해외에서 의약품 도매 및 소매업을 운영하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 화학 약품, 한약, 생물학적 제품 및 의약품을 제공합니다. 의료기기, 중의약 음편, 건강식품, 일용품, 유리제품, 화학시약 등; 전자상거래 플랫폼, 직접 판매, 직접 매장 체인, 온라인 B2C, O2O 등을 통해 제품을 제공합니다. 이 회사는 1950년에 설립되었으며 중국 하얼빈에 본사를 두고 있습니다. HPGC Renmintongtai Pharmaceutical Corporation은 Harbin Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd.의 자회사입니다.
